title: A community image generator joins the project list
summary:
A community-built image generator joined the project list, with model choices, adjustable settings, and a real-time preview.

The README and website project list now include @hrisjeui’s AI Image Generator, a Pollinations-powered web app with multiple models, adjustable parameters, and a real-time preview.

daily.title: Community image generator
daily.text: Try a community-built image generator with multiple models, adjustable parameters, and a real-time preview. [Explore community apps](https://pollinations.ai).
